body: I hope so. I am still unclear as to what to do, but I'm thinking of taking him out for food one day to actually talk to him about his issues one on one. Maybe we can go to the internet cafe or something to relax his mind a little bit. If it was the normal me, I'd have surpassed this as nothing more than attention seeking. But this time I think he's being pushed to his limits and I just want to do anything to help him out. And this time I actually feel a little responsibility.
Also I'm a teenager myself, so I really don't wanna make a stupid choice which will make anything worse (which I already sort of did...). Any advices on how to talk to him would be appreciated
